rows.label: qst650655_0002
rows.name: What? You had it all along!

rows.label: qst650655_0003
rows.name:
Huh?
What are you talking about?!

rows.label: qst650655_0004
rows.name: You were talking about a month ago!

rows.label: qst650655_0005
rows.name: I took that stone at least eight years ago!

rows.label: qst650655_0006
rows.name: Eight years?

rows.label: qst650655_0007
rows.name:
But Lazaro-san definitely said
it was a month ago[ML:Dash ]

rows.label: qst650655_0008
rows.name: You so-called Four Brothers of Steel.

rows.label: qst650655_0009
rows.name:
Do not imagine you can escape
with a lie made up on the spot.

rows.label: qst650655_0010
rows.name: Eep!

rows.label: qst650655_0011
rows.name: L-lie? N-no, I would never dream of it!

rows.label: qst650655_0012
rows.name: I swear on my dead mother, it's the truuuth!

rows.label: qst650655_0013
rows.name: Oh, your poor mother must be crying now.

rows.label: qst650655_0014
rows.name: Indeed[ML:Dash ]

rows.label: qst650655_0015
rows.name: Well, anyway, we got the Life Stone back.

rows.label: qst650655_0016
rows.name: Let's take it to old man Lazaro.

rows.label: qst650655_0017
rows.name: Yes!

rows.label: qst650655_0018
rows.name: No, there is no need for that.

rows.label: qst650655_0019
rows.name: Lazaro-san!

rows.label: qst650655_0020
rows.name: What, you've been following us all this time?

rows.label: qst650655_0021
rows.name: I never even noticed.

rows.label: qst650655_0022
rows.name: I could not sit still any longer.

rows.label: qst650655_0023
rows.name: I simply could not wait.

rows.label: qst650655_0024
rows.name:
Um, what you were looking for[ML:Dash ]
Is this the right thing?

rows.label: qst650655_0025
rows.name: Yes. Thank you.

rows.label: qst650655_0026
rows.name: Thank you so very much.

rows.label: qst650655_0027
rows.name: I have wanted to recover this for so long!

rows.label: qst650655_0028
rows.name:
Well then, I shall finish that doll
right away.

rows.label: qst650655_0029
rows.name: Wow, it's lovely.

rows.label: qst650655_0030
rows.name: It really looks so full of life.

rows.label: qst650655_0031
rows.name:
That's amazing, mo!
Tora wants to learn from a master craftsman, mo!

rows.label: qst650655_0032
rows.name: Oh, no, it's hardly anything so[ML:Dash ]
